newsitem.title: USA: US Treasuries retreat from Tuesday's lofty levels.
newsitem.headline: US Treasuries retreat from Tuesday's lofty levels.

text.p: The prices of U.S. government securities retreated on Wednesday from some of the lofty levels seen on Tuesday, amid heavy corporate debt issuance and a somewhat weaker U.S. dollar.
The 30-year bond ended down 9/32 at 96-8/32 to yield 6.79 percent.
Analysts said some players may have been looking to unwind some overly confident positions taken after benign consumer price data Tuesday. Volume was described as thin.
